rows.text: The Tongan release states that His Majesty King Tupou VI has appointed ('Kuo fakanofo') ''Eiki Nōpele Vaea', Nobles' Representative No. 2 for Tongatapu, as Speaker of the Fale Alea ('Eiki Sea 'o e Fale Alea 'o Tonga) in accordance with the Constitution, succeeding ''Eiki Nōpele Fakafanua', who was appointed Prime Minister ''aneafi' (yesterday); that the King also appointed ''Eiki Nōpele Tu'iha'angana' Deputy Speaker; and that the instruments of appointment, authorised and signed by the King, took effect from 18 December 2025 ('na'e kamata ngaue'aki ia mei he 'aho 18 Tīsema 2025').
rows.locator: Release body, paragraphs 1-3; issuing line (Kalake Pule)
rows.uncertainty: The royal appointment with its stated effective day, recorded separately from the Assembly's election (to_speaker_vaea_assembly_election_20251216) and the oath (to_speaker_vaea_oath_news_20260122). The source prints the Tongan name forms; the English release (to_speakers_appointment) prints 'Lord Vaea'. 'Succeeding 'Eiki Nōpele Fakafanua' is not used to date an end of Lord Fakafanua's Speakership. The existing string holder to_speakers_appointment already records this appointment, so no second holder rests on it.
